name: Spotlight Text
description: Full-screen SVG word mark hidden in darkness that is revealed by a swinging spotlight beam, with an outline stroke draw inside the light and a button to toggle the beam.
contents: SVG lettering drawn from path data
behavior: Spotlight swings left and right on an infinite alternating loop
Letters are revealed as outlined strokes inside the light and filled elsewhere
Stroke outline continuously draws in and out
Button fades the light cone in and out
Animations are disabled with reduced motion
editableByProps: Background image, background color, word fill and stroke colors
Button labels, initial light state, button colors
Button font family and font file

needsCodeEdit.change: Change swing speed, angle or pivot

fixed: Lettering is fixed SVG path data
Root fills the viewport height as a full-bleed section; override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto
